description: Shoulderpads of Faith Level 60 Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Shoulderpads of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Shoulderpads - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 12 - Mooncloth x 2 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3
name: Shoulderpads of Faith
